repos_data.description: Open tax skills for AI: 2,250 skills across 266 jurisdictions, every figure cited to the law. Works in ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor and any MCP client.
Official-source European VAT rates for Go. Daily-checked, embedded offline data for 45 jurisdictions.
Standard VAT rate in every EU member state on any date since 2016. Zero-dependency libraries for Node, Python and Java, plus an MCP server. Every rate change cites its source.
